sentences.text: The NSW Independent Commission Against Corruption provides guidance for officials responsible for facilities maintenance systems and contracts.
sentences.support: The purpose of this report is to guide public officials who are accountable for decisions about facilities maintenance systems

sentences.text: It draws on interviews with senior staff from 24 organisations and case studies to examine outsourced maintenance arrangements.
sentences.support: The report is informed by interviews with senior staff from 24 public and private sector organisations

sentences.text: The Commission concludes that effective maintenance controls require asset and cost knowledge, separation of key duties and connected information about performance.
sentences.support: Collecting and linking maintenance data about asset conditions and service history is a powerful method for preventing corruption.

sentences.text: The Commission advises agencies to select contracting arrangements that match their staff capabilities and information systems, then review them as circumstances change.
sentences.support: Agencies should design maintenance arrangements in accordance with their experience and capability.

findings.quote: Regardless of its commercial arrangements, an agency should aim to be an informed client.
Agencies should design maintenance arrangements in accordance with their experience and capability.

notes: Prevention guidance with no numbered formal recommendations list. The conclusion is on PDF page 38, not the printed page 36.
